title: Demand Uncertainty, Selection, and Trade
title_zh: 需求不确定性、选择与贸易
title_primary: 需求不确定性、选择与贸易
title_secondary: Demand Uncertainty, Selection, and Trade
authors: Erick Sager, Olga A. Timoshenko
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the effect of idiosyncratic uncertainty on trade elasticities in a canonical heterogeneous‐firm model. We identify two channels through which uncertainty affects elasticities: a selection effect, whereby uncertainty lowers export participation thresholds and a dispersion effect, whereby uncertainty lowers the dispersion of export selection shocks, with an ambiguous impact on elasticities. We develop a methodology to quantify trade elasticities under uncertainty and apply it to Brazilian firm‐level export data. Relative to a complete‐information framework, uncertainty amplifies trade elasticities on average, with heterogeneous effects across industries that are largest among highly substitutable and high‐uncertainty products.
abstract_zh: 本文在经典异质性企业模型中考察了特质性不确定性对贸易弹性的影响。我们识别出不确定性影响弹性的两个渠道：选择效应，即不确定性降低了出口参与门槛；以及离散效应，即不确定性降低了出口选择冲击的离散度，对弹性的影响方向不明确。我们开发了一种方法，用于量化不确定性条件下的贸易弹性，并将其应用于巴西企业层面的出口数据。与完全信息框架相比，不确定性平均放大了贸易弹性，且各行业间存在异质性影响，在高度可替代和高不确定性的产品中表现最为显著。

title: Pensions and Turbulence: Automatic Adjustment, Risk, and Fairness in Long-Term Pension Design
title_zh: 养老金与动荡：长期养老金设计中的自动调整、风险与公平性
title_primary: 养老金与动荡：长期养老金设计中的自动调整、风险与公平性
title_secondary: Pensions and Turbulence: Automatic Adjustment, Risk, and Fairness in Long-Term Pension Design
authors: Peter A. Diamond
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Public pension systems are long-term social contracts operating under persistent economic, demographic, and political uncertainty. Periods of turbulence, marked by financial shocks, changes in longevity, and shifting labour markets, test the capacity of pension institutions to adapt while maintaining adequacy, equity, and legitimacy. Building on earlier joint work on pension economics and reform with Nicholas Barr, this chapter analyses the role of automatic and semi-automatic adjustment mechanisms in public pension design. Drawing on comparative experience from Sweden, Canada, and the United States, we examine mechanisms for maintaining financial balance, the incorporation of life expectancy into retirement age and benefit design, and the accumulation and drawdown phases of defined contribution pensions. We argue that well-designed automatic mechanisms can discipline political decision-making and improve resilience, but only if they are proportionate, transparent, and attentive to distributional and intergenerational consequences. In turbulent times, good pension design does not eliminate the need for political choice; rather, it structures that choice so that adjustment can occur without repeated crises.

title: Do coupled population, economic, and land use dynamics explain household energy transitions in Malawi?
title_zh: 马拉维家庭能源转型是否可由人口、经济与土地利用的耦合动态解释？
title_primary: 马拉维家庭能源转型是否可由人口、经济与土地利用的耦合动态解释？
title_secondary: Do coupled population, economic, and land use dynamics explain household energy transitions in Malawi?
authors: Katerina E.B. Beach, Varun Goel, Yu Wu, Barbara Entwisle, Pamela Jagger
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In sub-Saharan Africa, population growth coupled with weak or missing markets for clean energy means that the absolute number of people relying on woodfuels for cooking is growing. Charcoal, which has distinctly different environmental and economic implications from firewood, has become one of the most consumed fuels in the region. However, among rural populations, the drivers and consequences of charcoal use remain under-studied. We examine rural woodfuel dynamics in Malawi, a majority rural country with high poverty, rapid population growth, lagging economic development, and abundant but rapidly declining forest resources. We examine how household energy transitions are influenced by concurrent demographic, economic, and land use changes. Using four waves of national household surveys and satellite-derived forest cover datasets, we investigate trends in household energy consumption, identify factors driving rural household fuel choices, and characterize geographic patterns of forest cover loss during 2004–2020. During this time, the share of rural households using charcoal grew from 3.9% to 13.4%. Rural households that are smaller, headed by younger individuals, and are asset-rich but land-poor had greater odds of using charcoal compared to firewood, indicating that rural livelihood dynamics have important consequences for household energy transitions. Several protected areas have experienced > 20% forest cover loss since 2001, characterized by geographic patterns consistent with unsanctioned woodfuel extraction. These findings emphasize a renewed need for integrated natural resources, energy, and livelihoods management strategies. Our insights provide information for policy makers to better predict and understand the continued growth of charcoal’s popularity in Malawi and similar contexts.
abstract_zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲，人口增长与清洁能源市场的薄弱或缺失并存，导致依赖木燃料做饭的绝对人口数量持续增加。木炭，因其与薪柴在环境和经济影响上存在显著差异，已成为该地区消费量最大的燃料之一。然而，在农村人口中，木炭使用的驱动因素及其后果研究仍显不足。我们以马拉维为研究对象，这是一个以农村人口为主的国家，面临高贫困率、快速人口增长、经济发展滞后以及森林资源丰富但迅速减少的挑战。我们探讨了家庭能源转型如何受到人口、经济和土地利用变化同步影响。利用四轮全国性家庭调查数据和卫星获取的森林覆盖数据集，我们分析了2004年至2020年间家庭能源消费的趋势，识别了影响农村家庭燃料选择的因素，并刻画了森林覆盖损失的地理格局。在此期间，使用木炭的农村家庭比例从3.9%上升至13.4%。相较于薪柴，规模较小、户主较年轻、资产丰富但土地匮乏的农村家庭更倾向于使用木炭，这表明农村生计动态对家庭能源转型具有重要影响。自2001年以来，多个保护区经历了超过20%的森林覆盖损失，其地理格局与未经许可的木燃料开采特征相符。这些发现强调了对自然资源、能源和生计管理进行综合策略的迫切需求。我们的研究为政策制定者提供了信息，以更好地预测和理解马拉维及类似背景下木炭普及度持续增长的趋势。

title: Revisiting the Lasting Impacts of Incarceration
title_zh: 重新审视监禁的持久影响
title_primary: 重新审视监禁的持久影响
title_secondary: Revisiting the Lasting Impacts of Incarceration
authors: John Humphries, Cecile Macaire, Aurelie Ouss, Megan Stevenson, Winnie Van Dijk
official: 官方在线 2025-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using newly-linked administrative and commercial data from Virginia spanning 25 years, we study the consequences of incarceration. While previous research has examined labor market outcomes and recidivism, we focus on two of the primary channels through which low-income households build wealth: asset ownership (homes and cars) and human capital formation. To identify causal effects, we use a matched difference-in-differences design. In line with much of the literature on the impact of incarceration in the U.S., we find no evidence of scarring effects on labor market outcomes or changes in recidivism beyond the incapacitation period. However, we find that incarceration leads to a persistent reduction in asset accumulation: seven years after sentencing, homeownership has declined by 1.1 percentage points (12.1%) and car ownership by 2.7 percentage points (18.1%). Incarceration also lowers human capital formation, reducing college enrollment by 1.4 percentage points (15.1%).
abstract_zh: 利用弗吉尼亚州跨越25年的新链接行政与商业数据，我们研究了监禁的后果。尽管先前的研究已考察了劳动力市场结果和再犯情况，我们则聚焦于低收入家庭积累财富的两大主要途径：资产所有权（住房和汽车）及人力资本形成。为识别因果效应，我们采用了匹配的双重差分设计。与美国关于监禁影响的大量文献一致，我们发现监禁对劳动力市场结果无疤痕效应，且在监禁期后未改变再犯率。然而，我们发现监禁导致资产积累持续减少：判决后七年，住房拥有率下降1.1个百分点（12.1%），汽车拥有率下降2.7个百分点（18.1%）。监禁还降低了人力资本形成，使大学入学率下降1.4个百分点（15.1%）。

title: Digital washing and corporate total factor productivity
title_zh: 数字化洗白与企业全要素生产率
title_primary: 数字化洗白与企业全要素生产率
title_secondary: Digital washing and corporate total factor productivity
authors: Shuwen Yang, Yong Liu, Huaxin Zhang, Haiying Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Based on a sample of 4,396 Chinese A-share listed companies from 2009 to 2024, this study explores the impact of digital washing as a selective disclosure strategy on corporate total factor productivity (TFP). The empirical findings are as follows. First, digital washing significantly improves corporate TFP. Second, mechanism tests reveal that digital washing promotes TFP by facilitating cooperative innovation, enhancing independent innovation capabilities and alleviating financing constraints. Third, dynamic effect analysis confirms a significant time-lag characteristic in the productivity-enhancing impact of digital washing. Fourth, the marginal effect of digital washing on total factor productivity follows an inverted U-shaped trend, which first increases and then decreases with the rise in digital washing intensity. For the vast majority of firms engaged in digital washing behaviours, their digital washing intensity falls within the reasonable range before the turning point. Market competition strengthens the promotional effect of digital washing on TFP, and only firms with a low level of actual digital transformation can effectively improve TFP through digital washing. The above findings indicate that digital washing is not merely a purely opportunistic behaviour. Firms should view it rationally, formulating differentiated disclosure strategies based on their resource endowments rather than blindly endorsing or avoiding it.
abstract_zh: 基于2009至2024年间4396家中国A股上市公司的样本，本研究探讨了选择性披露策略——数字漂洗——对企业全要素生产率的影响。实证结果显示：第一，数字漂洗显著提升了企业全要素生产率。第二，机制检验表明，数字漂洗通过促进合作创新、增强自主创新能力及缓解融资约束来推动全要素生产率的增长。第三，动态效应分析确认了数字漂洗对生产率提升作用存在显著的时滞特征。第四，数字漂洗对全要素生产率的边际效应呈倒U型趋势，即随着数字漂洗强度的增加，其效应先升后降。对于绝大多数实施数字漂洗行为的企业而言，其漂洗强度处于拐点之前的合理区间内。市场竞争强化了数字漂洗对全要素生产率的促进作用，且仅实际数字化转型程度较低的企业能通过数字漂洗有效提升全要素生产率。上述发现表明，数字漂洗并非纯粹的机会主义行为。企业应理性看待，依据自身资源禀赋制定差异化的披露策略，而非盲目推崇或回避。

title: Emergency department visits and temperature: Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: 急诊就诊与气温：来自墨西哥的证据
title_primary: 急诊就诊与气温：来自墨西哥的证据
title_secondary: Emergency department visits and temperature: Evidence from Mexico
authors: Luis Sarmiento, Francesco Pietro Colelli, Filippo Pavanello
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the impact of temperatures on emergency department visits using daily data from the universe of public hospitals in Mexico from 2008 to 2021. We find that cold temperatures decrease visits by up to 9.1 percent on the same day, and warm temperatures increase visits by as much as 3.7 percent. Using distributed lag models, we then show that cold temperatures can reduce visits for the next 30 days by up to 16 percent. For warm temperatures, contemporaneous and cumulative effects are similar (limited harvesting). These findings suggest that, unlike mortality, temperatures affect the demand for emergency services linearly. Leveraging the granularity of our dataset, we also document significant heterogeneities (e.g., higher sensitivity for children and teenagers) and provide suggestive evidence about mechanisms, such as ecosystem dynamics and behavioral changes. Finally, we project that — absent adaptation — temperature-driven annual emergency department visits might increase by 0.35 percent by midcentury, resulting in an estimated increase of 8.5 million USD in annual medical expenditures in Mexico.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2008年至2021年墨西哥公立医院全样本的每日数据，评估了气温对急诊就诊人次的影响。研究发现，寒冷天气会使当日就诊人次减少高达9.1%，而炎热天气则会使就诊人次增加多达3.7%。通过使用分布滞后模型，我们进一步揭示，寒冷天气可在未来30天内将就诊人次减少最多16%。对于炎热天气，同期效应与累积效应相似（即有限的“收获效应”）。这些结果表明，与死亡率不同，气温对急诊服务需求的影响呈线性关系。借助数据集的细粒度特性，我们还记录了显著的异质性（例如，儿童和青少年对气温变化更为敏感），并提供了关于机制（如生态系统动态和行为变化）的提示性证据。最后，我们预测——在缺乏适应措施的情况下——到本世纪中叶，由气温驱动的年度急诊就诊人次可能增加0.35%，这将导致墨西哥年度医疗支出预计增加850万美元。

title: Geopolitical Conflict and Trade: Montesquieu Revisited
title_zh: 地缘政治冲突与贸易：重访孟德斯鸠
title_primary: 地缘政治冲突与贸易：重访孟德斯鸠
title_secondary: Geopolitical Conflict and Trade: Montesquieu Revisited
authors: Jonas Adolph, Wilhelm Kohler, Gernot Müller, Emanuel Ornelas, John Turner 等
official: 官方在线 2025-12-03 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a simple model that jointly determines the level of trade and the extent of trade-disruption risk associated with geopolitical conflict. Any pair of countries is likely to settle into one of two steady states: (i) a low level of trade coupled with high trade-disruption risk, or (ii) a high level of trade coupled with low trade-disruption risk. Intermediate cases are unstable. Examining bilateral trade flows between 1966 and 2015, we find, first, that the extent of trade varies systematically with trade-disruption risk and, second, that trade between country pairs tends to converge over time toward these polar cases.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个简洁模型，该模型同时决定贸易水平及与地缘政治冲突相关的贸易中断风险程度。任意两国组合可能稳定于两种稳态之一：（i）低贸易水平伴随高贸易中断风险，或（ii）高贸易水平伴随低贸易中断风险。中间情形则不稳定。通过考察1966年至2015年间的双边贸易流，我们首先发现，贸易程度随贸易中断风险呈系统性变化；其次，国家间的贸易随时间趋于向这些极端情形收敛。

title: Good Unsystematic Mistakes
title_zh: 良好的非系统性错误
title_primary: 良好的非系统性错误
title_secondary: Good Unsystematic Mistakes
authors: Lina Lukyantseva, Alex Suzdaltsev
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the effects of consumers' unsystematic perception mistakes on market outcomes and consumer welfare. In the model, two firms produce goods of different quality and compete by choosing prices. Consumers observe the qualities and/or the prices with noise and make choice mistakes as a result. When the magnitude of mistakes grows, the lower‐quality firm increases its price while the higher‐quality firm initially reduces its price before increasing it. We show that this price reduction effect is so strong that consumers eventually benefit from making a small amount of unsystematic mistakes despite the sub‐optimal choices and the increasing price of the lower‐quality firm.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了消费者非系统性感知错误对市场结果和消费者福利的影响。在模型中，两家企业生产不同质量的商品，并通过选择价格进行竞争。消费者在观察质量和/或价格时存在噪声，从而导致选择错误。当错误幅度增大时，低质量企业提高其价格，而高质量企业则先降低价格后再提高。我们表明，这种降价效应如此显著，以至于消费者最终会因犯少量非系统性错误而受益，尽管存在次优选择及低质量企业价格上涨的情况。

title: Beyond Bilateral Flows: Indirect Connections and Exchange Rates
title_zh: 超越双边流动：间接联系与汇率
title_primary: 超越双边流动：间接联系与汇率
title_secondary: Beyond Bilateral Flows: Indirect Connections and Exchange Rates
authors: Saleem Bahaj, Pasquale Della Corte, Daniele Massacci, Eduard Seyde
official: 官方在线 2024-07-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how cross-border financial connections affect the response of exchange rates to trade shocks. Theoretically, we develop a multi-country model whereby a country's exchange rate depends on the financiers' ability to manage capital flows between this country and its counterparties (direct connection) and between its counterparties and their trading partners (indirect connection). Empirically, we quantify the network of financial connections using granular data on cross-border claims and liabilities of globally active banks. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, we find that indirect connection can either amplify or mitigate the impact of trade shocks on future exchange rate returns, depending on the shock's origin and size, while direct connection always dampens these effects.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了跨境金融联系如何影响汇率对贸易冲击的响应。理论上，我们构建了一个多国模型，其中一国的汇率取决于金融家管理该国与其交易对手之间资本流动的能力（直接联系），以及其交易对手与其贸易伙伴之间的资本流动能力（间接联系）。实证上，我们利用全球活跃银行的跨境债权与债务的细粒度数据，量化了金融联系网络。与我们的理论预测一致，我们发现间接联系可能放大或缓解贸易冲击对未来汇率回报的影响，这取决于冲击的来源和规模，而直接联系则始终削弱这些效应。

official: 官方在线 2020-04-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: There are several real world examples of local governments that, faced with budget problems, circulate a fiat token in parallel to the official currency. A well known case is the Argentinian “Patacon”, printed by the province of Buenos Aires during the crisis of 2001. We present a simple model to analyze the workings of monetary equilibria where the parallel currency is valued in equilibrium and discuss its consequence for real allocations in terms of an equivalent fiscal policy. We briefly discuss different model specifications and their fit to alternative historic experiences.
abstract_zh: 现实世界中存在多个地方政府面临预算问题时，在官方货币之外并行流通一种法定代币的实例。一个著名的案例是阿根廷的“帕塔贡”，由布宜诺斯艾利斯省在2001年危机期间发行。我们提出一个简单模型，分析平行货币在均衡中被估值时的货币均衡运作机制，并讨论其以等价财政政策形式对实际配置的影响。我们简要探讨不同的模型设定及其与不同历史经验的契合度。

title: Labor turnover, information production, and bank risk
title_zh: 劳动力流动、信息生产与银行风险
title_primary: 劳动力流动、信息生产与银行风险
title_secondary: Labor turnover, information production, and bank risk
authors: Lars Norden, Bernardus Van Doornik, Weichao Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate the theoretical mechanisms through which labor turnover adversely affects bank risk and performance. Using monthly matched employer-employee data from Brazil during 2003-2019, we find banks with higher labor turnover show lower risk buffers, greater loan losses, higher loan growth, and lower profitability. These adverse effects align with the firm-specific human capital theory. Consistent with our identifying assumptions, the effects are stronger when turnover reduces experience and expertise, among loan officers, as well as across cities and banks. Placebo tests and further analyses confirm our results. The evidence suggests that high labor turnover impairs bank information production, increasing risk and lowering performance.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了劳动力流动对银行风险与绩效产生不利影响的理论机制。利用2003-2019年间巴西月度匹配的雇主-雇员数据，我们发现劳动力流动率较高的银行表现出较低的风险缓冲、更大的贷款损失、更高的贷款增长以及较低的盈利能力。这些不利影响与公司特定人力资本理论相符。与我们的识别假设一致，当流动减少经验与专业知识时，在信贷员群体中，以及跨城市和银行间，这些效应更为显著。安慰剂检验及进一步分析证实了我们的结果。证据表明，高劳动力流动损害了银行的信息生产能力，从而增加了风险并降低了绩效。

title: A methodological framework for integrated climate adaptation and mitigation assessment in urban design
title_zh: 城市设计中气候适应与减缓综合评估的方法论框架
title_primary: 城市设计中气候适应与减缓综合评估的方法论框架
title_secondary: A methodological framework for integrated climate adaptation and mitigation assessment in urban design
authors: Guglielmo Ricciardi, Guido Callegari, Mattia Federico Leone
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate change is increasingly affecting buildings, infrastructure, natural systems, and socio-economic activities in urban areas, while cities also contribute significantly to global warming through high energy consumption and carbon emissions from buildings, transport, waste, and energy systems. In this context, urban design plays a crucial role in advancing climate-resilient and low-carbon development. However, existing assessment systems still tend to address climate change adaptation and mitigation separately, limiting the holistic evaluation of urban design scenarios. This study develops a methodological framework for the integrated assessment of climate change adaptation and mitigation in urban design. The framework is based on a structured set of key performance indicators and associated design measures to support the evaluation of built environment vulnerabilities, carbon emission drivers, and the performance of urban design scenarios across multiple scales and climate hazards in both urban regeneration and new development projects. The results show that current environmental assessment systems predominantly prioritize either mitigation or adaptation, without adequately capturing their interrelations within the built environment. The proposed framework addresses this gap by supporting scenario comparison and design decision-making through an integrated, multiscale approach. The findings also highlight the strategic role of green and blue measures for buildings and open spaces, as these solutions can simultaneously enhance climate adaptation and mitigation. Overall, the framework provides a coherent basis for more integrated climate-responsive urban design assessment.
abstract_zh: 气候变化日益影响城市地区的建筑、基础设施、自然系统和社会经济活动，同时，城市通过建筑、交通、废弃物和能源系统的高能耗与高碳排放，也对全球变暖产生显著贡献。在此背景下，城市设计在推进气候韧性和低碳发展方面发挥着关键作用。然而，现有评估体系仍倾向于将气候变化适应与减缓分开处理，限制了对城市设计方案的整体性评价。本研究构建了一个用于城市设计中气候变化适应与减缓综合评估的方法框架。该框架基于一套结构化的关键绩效指标及相关设计措施，以支持对建成环境脆弱性、碳排放驱动因素以及城市设计方案在多尺度和多种气候灾害下的表现进行评估，适用于城市更新和新建项目。结果表明，当前环境评估体系主要优先考虑减缓或适应中的某一方，未能充分捕捉建成环境中两者之间的相互关系。所提出的框架通过支持情景比较和设计决策，以综合、多尺度的方式弥补了这一不足。研究结果还强调了绿色和蓝色措施在建筑及开放空间中的战略作用，因为这些解决方案能够同时增强气候适应与减缓能力。总体而言，该框架为更综合的气候响应型城市设计评估提供了连贯的基础。

abstract: Customers in over‐the‐counter (OTC) markets must find a counterparty to trade. Little is known about this process, however, because existing data consist of transaction records, which only reveal the outcome of a search. Using data from a trading platform for corporate bonds, we unpack the search process. We analyze how long it takes customers to trade and how dealers' offers evolve across repeated inquiries. We estimate that it takes two to three days to complete a transaction after an unsuccessful attempt, with substantial variation across trade and customer characteristics. Our analysis offers insights into the sources of trading delays in OTC markets.
abstract_zh: 在场外交易（OTC）市场中，客户必须寻找交易对手方。然而，由于现有数据仅包含交易记录，仅能揭示搜索的结果，因此对这一过程知之甚少。利用公司债券交易平台的数据，我们揭示了搜索过程。我们分析了客户完成交易所需的时间，以及交易商在多次询价中报价的演变情况。我们估计，在一次不成功的尝试后，完成一笔交易需要两到三天时间，且这一时长因交易和客户特征的不同而有显著差异。我们的分析为理解OTC市场交易延迟的根源提供了见解。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Tax avoidance through personal holding companies has long been viewed as a key challenge for progressive income taxation. We exploit twenty years of administrative micro-data linking firms to owners in Sweden and Norway to analyze how the use of personal holding companies varies across the income distribution and to quantify its implications in a quasi-experimental setting. About half of the income of the top 0.1% is retained in personal holding companies defined, as in US tax law, as firms for which five or fewer owners own more than 50% of the stock and that derive more than 60% of income from investment income. Event studies of shocks to operational firms' value-added show that holding companies shield around half of dividend distributions from individual income taxation. Profits tend to remain in holding companies for long periods of time, with cumulative payout rates of 15%-20% over two decades for the highest income groups. Wealth taxes do not provide an effective backstop due to the low valuation (or exemption) of shares in private businesses. As a result, effective tax rates, all taxes included, fall from about 50% for the upper middle class to about 15%-20% among the highest-net-worth individuals.
abstract_zh: 通过个人控股公司进行避税长期以来一直被视为累进所得税制面临的关键挑战。我们利用瑞典和挪威二十年间将企业与所有者关联的行政微观数据，分析个人控股公司的使用如何随收入分配变化，并在准实验环境中量化其影响。根据美国税法定义，个人控股公司指由五名或更少所有者持有超过50%股份，且超过60%收入来源于投资收入的企业。在最高收入0.1%群体中，约一半收入留存于此类控股公司。对经营性企业增加值冲击的事件研究表明，控股公司能规避约一半股息分配的个人所得税。利润往往长期留存于控股公司，最高收入群体在二十年间的累计派息率仅为15%-20%。由于私人企业股份估值偏低（或免税），财富税无法有效弥补这一漏洞。因此，包括所有税收在内的有效税率，从中上阶层的约50%降至最高净值个人的约15%-20%。

abstract: The paper develops a forward-looking comprehensive accounting framework for the public sector. By integrating the public sector budget constraint forward in time the government's present value budget constraint (PVBC) is obtained. In addition to the familiar financial assets and liabilities, comprehensive public sector net worth contains the following items: the value of the public sector capital stock; the value of public sector property rights in land and natural resources; the present value of future seigniorage, the present value of future taxes net of transfers and subsidies and the present value of future planned public sector capital formation, privatization or nationalization programmes. From the "stock" PVBC a number of different "flow" deficit concepts are derived; each one emphasizes a different aspect of the "sustainability" of current and/or prospective fiscal and financial plans. Together they provide a framework for organizing facts and plans about fiscal, financial and monetary policy and for evaluating the consistency of spending and revenue projections or scenarios, public sector debt objectives and monetary targets.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个面向公共部门的前瞻性综合核算框架。通过将公共部门预算约束向前延伸，推导出政府现值预算约束（PVBC）。除常见的金融资产与负债外，综合公共部门净值包含以下项目：公共部门资本存量价值；公共部门对土地及自然资源的产权价值；未来铸币税收入的现值；未来转移支付与补贴净额的税收现值；以及未来计划中的公共部门资本形成、私有化或国有化项目的现值。基于“存量”PVBC，衍生出多种不同的“流量”赤字概念，每种概念分别强调当前及/或预期财政金融计划“可持续性”的不同维度。这些概念共同构成一个分析框架，用于整理财政、金融与货币政策的事实与规划，评估支出与收入预测或情景、公共部门债务目标及货币目标之间的一致性。

title_zh: 高效学费与杂费、考试及补贴

authors: Robert J. Gary-Bobo, Alain Trannoy
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A student's future log-wage is given by the sum of a skill premium and a random personal ?ability? term. Students observe only a private, noisy signal of their ability, and universities can condition admission decisions on the results of noisy tests. We assume first that universities are maximizing social surplus, and contrast the results with those obtained when they maximize rents. If capital markets are perfect, and if test results are public knowledge, then, there is no sorting on the basis of test scores. Students optimally self-select as a result of pricing only. In the absence of externalities generated by an individual's higher education, the optimal tuition is then greater than the university's marginal cost. If capital markets are perfect but asymmetries of information are bilateral, i.e., if universities observe a private signal of each student's ability, or if there are borrowing constraints, then, the optimal policy involves a mix of pricing and pre-entry selection based on the university's private information. Optimal tuition can then be set below marginal cost, and can even become negative, if the precision of the university's private assessment of students' abilities is high enough.
abstract_zh: 学生的未来对数工资由技能溢价和随机个人“能力”项之和决定。学生仅能观察到自身能力的私人噪声信号，而大学可依据噪声测试结果决定录取条件。我们首先假设大学以最大化社会剩余为目标，并将其与追求租金最大化时的结果进行对比。若资本市场完善且测试结果为公共知识，则不存在基于测试分数的筛选。学生仅通过定价机制实现最优自我选择。在个人高等教育不产生外部性的前提下，最优学费将高于大学的边际成本。若资本市场完善但信息不对称具有双向性——即大学能观察到每位学生能力的私人信号，或存在借贷约束——则最优政策需结合定价与基于大学私人信息的入学前筛选。当大学对学生能力的私人评估精度足够高时，最优学费可低于边际成本，甚至可能为负值。

abstract: We develop an incomplete-contracting model in which the government engages a private contractor to provide a public good. Over time, adaptations of the good to changing circumstances may become desirable. The contractor privately learns the costs of implementing these adaptations. We compare two organizational forms. In a public-private partnership, the government actively participates in project management and, by incurring information-gathering costs, may ascertain the contractor's adaptation costs. Under traditional procurement, the government lacks direct involvement in project management, preventing it from ascertaining the adaptation costs. We show that the government's potentially enhanced access to the contractor's information in a public-private partnership can either support or undermine the case for such partnerships.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个不完全契约模型，其中政府委托私人承包商提供公共产品。随着时间推移，根据环境变化对产品进行调整可能变得可取。承包商私下了解实施这些调整的成本。我们比较了两种组织形式。在公私合作关系中，政府积极参与项目管理，并通过承担信息收集成本，可能查明承包商的调整成本。在传统采购下，政府缺乏对项目管理的直接参与，无法查明调整成本。我们表明，在公私合作关系中，政府可能增强对承包商信息的获取，这既可能支持也可能削弱此类合作关系的合理性。

title: Revolutionizing the underworld: Can the digital economy shrink the informal economy?

authors: Zhike Lv, Wenqing Dai, Lei Han, Lingling Jiang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The informal economy has come under increasing scrutiny. Rather than relying on coercive measures, efforts should focus on formalizing the informal economy by expanding the formal sector, with the digital economy playing a pivotal role in this transition. This study examines the influence of the digital economy on the informal economy across 89 countries from 2003 to 2017, using a two-way fixed effects regression method. The study draws the following conclusions. Firstly, the digital economy contributes to a significant reduction in the size of the informal economy, a result supported by robustness tests. Secondly, the mechanism test results reveal that this reduction is driven by improvements in institutional quality and financial inclusion. Finally, the heterogeneity test suggests that the influence of the digital economy is particularly strong in countries with higher levels of economic development and educational attainment. Overall, these findings complement existing studies, deliver helpful implications for policymakers, and suggest some new lines for future research.
abstract_zh: 非正规经济日益受到关注。与其依赖强制措施，不如通过扩大正规部门来实现非正规经济的正规化，而数字经济在这一转型过程中扮演着关键角色。本研究利用双向固定效应回归方法，考察了2003年至2017年间89个国家数字经济对非正规经济的影响。研究得出以下结论：首先，数字经济显著缩小了非正规经济的规模，这一结果得到了稳健性检验的支持。其次，机制检验结果显示，这种缩减得益于制度质量的提升和金融包容性的增强。最后，异质性检验表明，在经济发展水平和教育程度较高的国家，数字经济的影响尤为显著。总体而言，这些发现补充了现有研究，为政策制定者提供了有益的启示，并为未来研究开辟了新的方向。

abstract: We investigate the long-term effects of cash assistance on beneficiaries and their children among participants in the Seattle-Denver Income Maintenance Experiment. Treated families in this randomized experiment received thousands of dollars in extra government benefits for three or five years in the 1970s. We match experimental records to Social Security Administration data using a novel algorithm, finding that treatment decreased adults’ post-experimental annual earnings by $1,800, and increased their disability benefit applications. Effects were strongest around retirement age; evidence suggests possible occupational mechanisms. In contrast, children experienced no significant effects on earnings or interaction with the disability system.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了西雅图-丹佛收入维持实验中现金援助对受益者及其子女的长期影响。在该随机实验中，受助家庭在20世纪70年代额外获得了为期三年或五年的数千美元政府补助。我们采用新型算法将实验记录与社会保障管理局数据进行匹配，发现实验干预使成年受助者在实验后的年收入减少1800美元，并增加了其残疾福利申请。影响在退休年龄前后最为显著；证据表明可能存在职业层面的作用机制。相比之下，子女在收入或与残疾系统的互动方面未受到显著影响。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To detect the global community structure of multi-layer networks, individual layers might not provide sufficient information. It is of vital importance to effectively complement the information from the network data. In this paper, under the framework of multi-layer stochastic block model, a Spectral method with Moments integration and Bias Adjustment (SpecMBA) is proposed for community detection. The key distinguishing feature of SpecMBA is the adaptive integration of both the first and second moments of adjacency matrices with a hyperparameter α∈[−1,∞), which overcomes the limitations of fixed-form aggregation. Furthermore, SpecMBA adjusts for the bias caused by noise heteroskedasticity to mitigate signal distortion. In addition, a data-driven likelihood-based approach is proposed to select the optimal α. This adaptive aggregation ensures robust and competitive performance across diverse scenarios, which has been confirmed in the numerical studies. Under mild conditions, the community detection consistency for SpecMBA is established. The application on the international food trading network reveals interesting findings.
abstract_zh: 为检测多层网络的全局社区结构，单一层可能无法提供足够的信息。有效补充网络数据中的信息至关重要。本文在多层随机块模型框架下，提出了一种结合矩积分与偏差调整的谱方法（SpecMBA），用于社区检测。SpecMBA的关键特征在于，通过超参数α∈[−1,∞)自适应整合邻接矩阵的一阶和二阶矩，克服了固定形式聚合的局限性。此外，SpecMBA调整了由噪声异方差性引起的偏差，以减轻信号失真。同时，提出了一种基于似然的数据驱动方法，用于选择最优α。这种自适应聚合确保了在不同场景下的稳健且具有竞争力的性能，这一点已在数值研究中得到证实。在温和条件下，建立了SpecMBA的社区检测一致性。在国际食品贸易网络上的应用揭示了有趣的发现。

title: Ecological rationality and the maximum entropy heuristic

abstract: This article analyses the notion of Ecological Rationality in the context of decision making under uncertainty. It suggests that constructivist approaches, namely constructivist rationality, are not adapted to solve problems faced in the real ecological environments, which imply large world problems and intractability. The complexity of the decision problems imply search and information costs and thus heuristics, as exhibited by human decision makers might be optimal. It is suggested that inverse S-shaped probability weighting as exhibited by most decision makers might be optimal when facing real world environments. It is shown that the maximum entropy approach can be used to model such kind of behaviour as an approximation to the inverse S-shaped probability weighting. It is argued that this approach is ecologically rational and that such a heuristic can be used to treat financial and econometric decision problems and be a calibrated to decision-makers ambiguity aversion.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了不确定性决策背景下“生态理性”的概念。研究指出，建构主义方法（即建构理性）并不适用于解决真实生态环境中的问题，这类问题涉及“大世界”困境与不可解性。决策问题的复杂性意味着搜索成本与信息成本的存在，因此人类决策者所展现的启发式策略可能具有最优性。研究表明，多数决策者表现出的反S形概率权重在真实环境决策中可能具有最优性。本文论证了最大熵方法可作为反S形概率权重的近似模型来模拟此类行为，并指出该路径具有生态理性特征，可应用于金融与计量经济决策问题，同时能校准决策者的模糊厌恶倾向。

abstract: We study how an agent evaluates an action when she observes a sample of its outcomes rather than its outcome-generating distribution. We propose a model where the agent’s estimated value for the action is a convex combination of her average utility over the sample outcomes and an ex ante utility reflecting her prior information. The weight put on the average utility increases with sample size, reflecting the inferential advantages of larger samples. The model nests certain forms of Bayesian behaviour and, more generally, identifies parameters quantifying departures from Bayesian updating, such as conservatism and the Law of Small Numbers.

abstract: This paper studies how demand curvature limits first-mover advantage and shapes surplus division in a Stackelberg duopoly facing α -concave demand for α ∈ [ − 1 , ∞ ) . Under constant symmetric marginal costs, I prove that across all possible equilibria, the leader-to-follower profit ratio is at least 1 + 5 + 4 α 2 . Thus, the leader is guaranteed to earn at least 61.8% more than the follower under log-concave demand ( α = 0 ) and at least twice as much under concave demand ( α = 1 ). Under demand with decreasing marginal revenue ( α = − 1 ), the leadership advantage persists. I further derive a lower bound for the leader’s profit alongside an upper bound for deadweight loss. Extremal demand curves D for which D α and ln D are affine attain all bounds for α > − 1 .

title_zh: 气候冲击与企业环境信息披露：来自中国的证据

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article investigates how climate shocks affect firms’ environmental disclosure decisions. Using a large panel of A-share listed firms, we combine firm-level disclosure data with regional measures of climate shocks. We estimate the effects using a two-way fixed-effects framework, complemented by a quasi-natural experiment based on the 2021 Henan extreme rainfall event. We find that climate shocks lead firms to significantly increase the level of environmental disclosure, and this result is robust to a range of alternative checks. Mechanism analyses suggest that climate shocks intensify external stakeholder pressure and enhance firms’ internal environmental awareness, thereby encouraging greater disclosure. The disclosure response is more pronounced among manufacturing firms, heavily polluting firms, high-carbon emitters, and non-state-owned enterprises, and is concentrated in dimensions subject to heightened regulatory attention. We further show that increases in environmental disclosure are associated with improvements in firms’ green governance performance and positive spillover effects on upstream suppliers. This study provides new evidence on firm responses to exogenous shocks through information disclosure under increasing climate uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了气候冲击如何影响企业的环境信息披露决策。利用A股上市公司的庞大面板数据，我们将企业层面的披露数据与区域气候冲击指标相结合，采用双向固定效应模型进行估计，并辅以基于2021年河南极端降雨事件的准自然实验。研究发现，气候冲击促使企业显著提升环境信息披露水平，且该结果在一系列稳健性检验中保持一致。机制分析表明，气候冲击增强了外部利益相关者的压力，并提升了企业内部的环境意识，从而推动更充分的信息披露。这一披露响应在制造业企业、重污染企业、高碳排放企业及非国有企业中更为显著，并集中于受监管关注度较高的维度。我们进一步证明，环境信息披露的增加与企业绿色治理绩效的改善相关，并对上游供应商产生正向溢出效应。本研究为日益加剧的气候不确定性下企业通过信息披露应对外生冲击提供了新的证据。

abstract: Does climate risk necessarily raise sovereign default risk? While a growing literature documents adverse effects from realized disasters, the implications of long-term (chronic) climate risk remain unclear. Using an endogenous default model with climate shocks, we isolate chronic physical risk from acute disaster realizations. We show that higher climate risk can increase sovereign bond prices by reducing default incentives. Risk-averse governments value continued market access as insurance against future shocks, strengthening repayment motives. While acute disasters still depress prices on impact, chronic risk can operate through a precautionary channel.
abstract_zh: 气候风险是否必然导致主权违约风险上升？尽管越来越多的文献记录了已发生的灾害所带来的不利影响，但长期（慢性）气候风险的影响仍不明确。通过构建包含气候冲击的内生违约模型，我们将慢性物理风险与急性灾害实现区分开来。研究表明，较高的气候风险可能通过降低违约激励来提高主权债券价格。风险厌恶型政府将持续的市场准入视为对未来冲击的保险，从而增强了偿还动机。尽管急性灾害在发生时仍会压低价格，但慢性风险可通过预防性渠道发挥作用。

abstract: While mobile-source emission standards have been widely implemented for decades, their effectiveness remains underexplored. This paper evaluates the impact of California’s Low Emission Vehicle (LEV) program on ambient air pollution by exploiting its staggered adoption across states. Using a large panel of monitor-day observations from 1985–2014 matched with daily weather data, I employ a modern staggered difference-in-differences framework to compare air-pollution trends in LEV and never-LEV states. The event-study results show no evidence of pre-trends and reveal a gradual build-up of treatment effects over roughly a decade after adoption. On average over the sample period, the LEV program reduces daily maximum ozone concentrations by 4.78%. The program’s impact is more pronounced during summer months and in urban and suburban regions, and these patterns are robust to restricting the sample to long-running monitors, excluding border monitors, and reweighting the data using a synthetic-control difference-in-differences procedure. These findings provide empirical evidence on the effectiveness of vehicle-emission standards and contribute to the broader literature on environmental regulation and mobile-source pollution control.
abstract_zh: 尽管移动源排放标准已实施数十年，但其有效性仍未得到充分探讨。本文通过利用各州分阶段采纳加州低排放车辆（LEV）计划的情况，评估该计划对空气质量的影响。利用1985年至2014年间与每日天气数据匹配的大规模监测站日观测面板数据，我采用现代交错双重差分框架，比较了采纳LEV计划州与从未采纳州之间的空气污染趋势。事件研究结果显示，不存在预趋势证据，并揭示了采纳后约十年内处理效应的逐步累积。在样本期间平均而言，LEV计划使每日最大臭氧浓度降低了4.78%。该计划的影响在夏季月份及城市和郊区更为显著，且这些模式在限制样本为长期运行监测站、排除边境监测站以及使用合成控制双重差分程序重新加权数据后依然稳健。这些发现为车辆排放标准的有效性提供了实证证据，并对环境规制与移动源污染控制的更广泛文献有所贡献。

title: Buying blind? Physical blind boxes in China generally comply with age restrictions and are reasonably transparent

title_primary: 盲目购买？中国实体盲盒普遍遵守年龄限制且透明度合理
title_secondary: Buying blind? Physical blind boxes in China generally comply with age restrictions and are reasonably transparent
authors: Xiaoyao, Ren, Huang, Yuchen, Xiao, Leon Y.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Background and Aims: Blind boxes are physical gambling-like products that consumers buy to receive random prizes, often only with a small chance of obtaining a specific product they desire. These products became globally popular in 2025 and are currently not legally regulated as a form of gambling, so children can buy them. Stakeholders are concerned about potential risks, including overspending and gambling-related harm. China is the first and only country to publish dedicated blind box regulatory policy, requiring age restrictions and transparency. Children under 8 are not allowed to buy blind boxes, and minors aged between 8 and 17 must have parental consent for purchasing. The probabilities of obtaining different random prizes must be disclosed. We assessed whether these policies have been duly implemented on the physical packaging of blind boxes manufactured and sold in China. Design: We conveniently purchased a diverse range of 50 blind boxes, including both well-known brands and lesser-known products. We then analysed all information shown on the physical packaging to identify compliance-related elements. Setting: Shenzhen, China Cases: 50 physical blind boxes purchased in November 2025. Measurements: The presence of age restriction information, parental consent requirement, and probability disclosures, and the visual prominence of probability disclosures. Findings: All products (100%) stated that they are not suitable for young children under 8, but 40% failed to also highlight the parental consent requirement for older children aged between 8 and 17. Probabilities were disclosed accurately and completely by 32% of blind boxes, whilst another 48% provided rounded up but still reasonably accurate and complete disclosures, so only 20% failed to disclose sufficiently or at all. The majority (66%) of blind boxes’ disclosed probabilities reasonably visually prominently, but a minority hid relevant information on multiple sides of the packaging (12%) or within a block of descriptive text (8%), making them harder for consumers to find. Conclusions: We observed relatively high compliance with Chinese blind box regulations, in terms of age restrictions and probabilistic transparency, although further improvements are required, particularly in relation to the parental consent requirement for older children and the visual prominence of probability disclosures.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：盲盒是一种类似赌博的实体产品，消费者购买后随机获得奖品，通常只有极小概率能抽到心仪商品。这类产品于2025年在全球流行，目前尚未被法律界定为赌博形式，因此儿童可以购买。利益相关方担忧其潜在风险，包括过度消费和赌博相关危害。中国是首个也是唯一发布专门盲盒监管政策的国家，要求实施年龄限制和信息透明。8岁以下儿童禁止购买盲盒，8至17岁未成年人购买需经家长同意，且必须公开不同随机奖品的获取概率。本研究评估了这些政策是否在中国制造和销售的盲盒实体包装上得到有效落实。 设计：我们便利购买了50个涵盖知名品牌与冷门产品的多样化盲盒，随后分析实体包装上所有信息以识别合规相关要素。 场景：中国深圳 案例：2025年11月购买的50个实体盲盒。 测量指标：年龄限制信息、家长同意要求、概率披露的呈现情况，以及概率披露的视觉显著性。 发现：所有产品（100%）均标注“不适用于8岁以下幼童”，但40%未同时强调8至17岁儿童需家长同意的要求。32%的盲盒准确完整披露了概率，另有48%提供了四舍五入但依然合理准确的完整披露，仅20%未充分披露或完全未披露。大多数盲盒（66%）的概率披露在视觉上具有合理显著性，但少数产品将相关信息隐藏在包装多个侧面（12%）或描述性文本段落中（8%），增加了消费者查找难度。 结论：在年龄限制和概率透明度方面，中国盲盒法规的合规率相对较高，但仍有改进空间，尤其需强化对较大儿童的家长同意要求及概率披露的视觉显著性。

title: UK Food standards agency proposals for re-structuring how it regulates food-borne risks: an analysis and critique

authors: Erik Millstone
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Official food policy-makers are expected both to ensure that they have a well-functioning system of food supply, processing, distribution and consumption while also ensuring that their citizens are protected from unsafe and unhealthy foods. It is evident that the implications of those two responsibilities can and sometimes do conflict; which historically has prompted the question: should those two policy responsibilities be institutionally co-located, or institutionally separated? The UK’s Food Standards Agency (FSA) was created in response to the policy failures revealed by the Mad Cow Disease saga. Previously one UK ministry had been responsible for both agendas, but the tension between them had been so severe that they contributed to turning the saga into a deep crisis. Responsibility for ensuring UK food safety was subsequently separated from the food industries’ sponsoring ministry, and transferred to the FSA. A recent set of proposals from the FSA recommends that the agency should expand its responsibilities by also endeavouring to promote the commercial interests of the food industries. Implementing the proposals risks undermining public confidence in the FSA and the safety of the UK’s food supply. The significance of the proposals goes beyond the UK as it illustrates a pivotal and ubiquitous axis of contestation in food policy-making, it illustrates ways in which food policy governance can be malleable rather than rigid, and explains how a combination of forgetfulness and economic re-prioritisation risks undermining food safety and public trust in policy-making.
abstract_zh: 官方食品政策制定者既被期望确保其拥有一个运作良好的食品供应、加工、分销和消费体系，同时也要确保其公民免受不安全和不健康食品的危害。显然，这两项职责的含义有时可能且确实会发生冲突；这在历史上引发了一个问题：这两项政策职责应在制度上合并还是分离？英国食品标准局（FSA）是为应对疯牛病事件所暴露的政策失败而设立的。此前，英国一个部委同时负责这两项议程，但两者之间的紧张关系如此严重，以至于它们共同促使该事件演变为一场深刻危机。确保英国食品安全的职责随后从食品行业的赞助部委中分离出来，并转移至FSA。FSA最近提出的一系列建议主张，该机构应通过努力促进食品行业的商业利益来扩大其职责范围。实施这些建议可能损害公众对FSA及英国食品供应安全的信任。这些建议的意义超越了英国本身，因为它展示了食品政策制定中一个关键且普遍存在的争议轴心，说明了食品政策治理如何具有可塑性而非僵化性，并解释了遗忘与经济重新优先排序的结合如何可能损害食品安全及公众对政策制定的信任。

abstract: We establish that inefficiently lax financial regulation can arise democratically. Lax regulation leads to banks issuing risky mortgages at less than actuarially fair interest rates. This creates additional demand for houses and increases house prices, generating nontrivial distribution of winners and losers. Renters and individuals with large nonhousing wealth suffer from the induced banking fragility, while young middle-wealth households benefit from mispriced mortgages and old homeowners benefit from higher house prices. When these latter two groups constitute a majority, regulatory failure can be a democratic outcome. Voting patterns in US Congress provide empirical support for this mechanism.
abstract_zh: 我们证实，效率低下的宽松金融监管可能通过民主程序产生。宽松监管导致银行以低于精算公平利率的水平发放高风险抵押贷款，这额外推高了住房需求并抬升房价，从而在赢家与输家之间形成不容忽视的分布格局。租房者及拥有大量非住房财富的个人因由此引发的银行脆弱性而受损，而年轻的中等财富家庭则从错误定价的抵押贷款中获益，老年房主则因房价上涨而受益。当后两个群体构成多数时，监管失灵便可能成为民主选举的结果。美国国会的投票模式为这一机制提供了实证支持。

title: Vertical integration and the modernization of staple food value chains: Evidence from Myanmar’s rice sector
title_zh: 纵向一体化与主食价值链现代化：来自缅甸稻米部门的证据
title_primary: 纵向一体化与主食价值链现代化：来自缅甸稻米部门的证据
title_secondary: Vertical integration and the modernization of staple food value chains: Evidence from Myanmar’s rice sector
authors: Goeb, Joseph, Minten, Bart, Reardon, Thomas, Zu, A Myint, Htar, May Thet
official: 官方在线 2026-04-23 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
abstract_zh: 在中低收入国家，农业价值链的转型与现代化进程中，纵向整合与协调的增强是显著特征，这对市场效率和农场层面转型具有重要影响。然而，关于国内价值链现代化进程中这些过程的文献研究有限，且往往聚焦于外国直接投资和高价值食品。我们以缅甸稻米价值链——东南亚最重要的主食——为研究对象，利用国内稻米加工厂和农户的独特数据，分析加工厂向其他业务和服务的扩张。研究表明，现代和传统加工厂均作为当地稻米价值链的关键节点，在农场和农场后层面发挥超越加工环节的多元作用，凸显了现代加工与纵向整合的协同发展。然而，分别控制加工厂和农户特征的统计检验显示，现代加工厂在纵向整合与协调方面参与度更高，尤其在农场后价值链环节，这进一步印证了现代加工与业务扩张的协同发展。与加工厂数据中的这一模式一致，使用现代加工厂的农户更有可能获得补充性服务（尤其是农场后服务），并更广泛地采用现代生产实践。然而，这种扩张并不均衡，大型农场比中小型农场更频繁地受益。

title: Markups, pass-through, and firm heterogeneity with sequentially mixed search
title_zh: 顺序混合搜索中的加成、传导与企业异质性
title_primary: 顺序混合搜索中的加成、传导与企业异质性
title_secondary: Markups, pass-through, and firm heterogeneity with sequentially mixed search
authors: Alex Chernoff, Allen Head, Beverly Lapham
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The determination of firm- and industry-level market power is studied in a model with search frictions driven by matching and incomplete information and in which heterogeneous firms compete for sales to ex ante homogeneous buyers. Combining directed search and random meetings sequentially, market tightness and the distributions of prices and productivity across active firms are determined jointly in equilibrium. We relate firm-level variation in prices and markups to variation in the elasticity of demand at the firm level. These distributions respond endogenously to changes in variable costs, utility from consumption, fixed costs of both entry and operation, and the consumer search process. We refer to these responses as pass-through and characterize them for both individual firms and the industry average. We show further that owing to the equilibrium determination of market tightness and the price distribution in directed search, improvements in consumer welfare may be associated with either increases or decreases in average markups.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个由匹配和不完全信息驱动的搜索摩擦模型中，研究了企业层面和行业层面的市场势力决定问题，其中异质性企业竞争向事前同质的买家销售产品。通过将定向搜索与随机相遇顺序结合，市场紧度以及活跃企业间的价格和生产率分布在内生均衡中共同决定。我们将企业层面的价格和加成率变动与企业层面需求弹性的变动联系起来。这些分布会对可变成本、消费效用、进入和运营的固定成本以及消费者搜索过程的变化作出内生反应。我们将这些反应称为传导效应，并分别刻画单个企业和行业平均水平的传导特征。我们进一步表明，由于定向搜索中市场紧度和价格分布的均衡决定，消费者福利的改善可能与平均加成率的上升或下降相关联。

title: Evaluating large‐scale government investments in fertilizer adoption: The Ethiopian experience
title_zh: 评估大规模政府化肥推广投资：埃塞俄比亚的经验
title_primary: 评估大规模政府化肥推广投资：埃塞俄比亚的经验
title_secondary: Evaluating large‐scale government investments in fertilizer adoption: The Ethiopian experience
authors: Thomas Assefa, Ellen McCullough, Guush Berhane
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We evaluate the impact of a large Government of Ethiopia intervention to raise fertilizer supply by establishing five fertilizer blending facilities supplying fertilizers tailored to local soil nutrient profiles. We rely on the phased geographic rollout of blending facility establishment to identify the causal effect on fertilizer use, application rates, crop yields, gross crop revenue, and household consumption. Combining effects of multiple treatment periods, each estimated using a doubly robust difference-in-difference model, we find that the blending facilities increased the probability that farmers adopt the new blended fertilizers by 22 percentage points and increased application rates by 17 kg/ha (baseline adoption was zero). The facilities mostly induced farmers who previously used DAP to switch to NPS, and we find large decreases in DAP adoption (by 22 percentage points, 47% of the control group base mean) and application rates (16 kg/ha, 52% of the control group base mean) yet no impact on overall fertilizer adoption or application rates. Though the new blended fertilizers were expected to perform better, there is no evidence they improved crop yields, crop gross revenue, or household consumption. The effect of the intervention was more pronounced (with larger increases in NPS use and larger decreases in DAP use) for farms located near demonstration plots, which the Government used to train farmers about the agronomic response to the new fertilizers. We confirm results using three large-scale longitudinal datasets and show that they are robust to choices of specification, treatment definition, and inference assumptions.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了埃塞俄比亚政府一项大规模干预措施的影响，该措施通过建立五家肥料混合设施，供应针对当地土壤养分特征定制的肥料，以提高肥料供应。我们利用混合设施建立的分阶段地理推广来识别其对肥料使用、施用量、作物产量、作物毛收入及家庭消费的因果效应。结合多个处理期的效应，每个处理期均采用双重稳健差分中的差分模型进行估计，我们发现这些混合设施使农民采用新型混合肥料的概率提高了22个百分点，施用量增加了17公斤/公顷（基线采用率为零）。这些设施主要促使先前使用DAP的农民转向NPS，我们观察到DAP采用率大幅下降（下降22个百分点，占对照组基期均值的47%）及施用量减少（16公斤/公顷，占对照组基期均值的52%），但对总体肥料采用率或施用量无影响。尽管预期新型混合肥料表现更佳，但没有证据表明它们改善了作物产量、作物毛收入或家庭消费。该干预措施的效果在靠近示范田的农场中更为显著（NPS使用增加更多，DAP使用减少更多），政府利用这些示范田向农民培训新肥料的农艺响应。我们使用三个大规模纵向数据集确认了结果，并表明这些结果对规格选择、处理定义及推断假设具有稳健性。

title: Legalization and innovation in the cannabis market
title_zh: 大麻市场的合法化与创新
title_primary: 大麻市场的合法化与创新
title_secondary: Legalization and innovation in the cannabis market
authors: Lucy Xiaolu Wang, Nathan W. Chan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: How would legal institutions affect the rate and direction of innovation in restricted or illicit markets? This paper studies the impact of legalization on innovation in the cannabis market. We construct novel data and measures on cannabis-related innovation in clinical trials and patent applications at the state-year level. We use staggered difference-in-differences models and event studies to analyze the impacts of medical and recreational cannabis legalization (MCL and RCL, respectively) on innovation. We find no evidence that cannabis-related clinical trials respond to MCLs or RCLs. However, there is a marked increase in cannabis-related patenting ( ∼ 4.4 patents) in response to an RCL and more modest impacts from an MCL ( ∼ 1.4 patents). Notably, additional RCL-induced patents are focused primarily on downstream products and methods rather than upstream medical innovation; MCL impacts show a similar pattern. Our further analysis of patent content suggests significant growth in areas that may raise public health, safety, and misuse concerns. These results suggest that legalization increases innovation in the cannabis market, but with relatively weak gains in areas pertinent to health and safe use. We corroborate our findings with multiple new empirical methods in the literature.
abstract_zh: 法律制度如何影响受限或非法市场中的创新速率与方向？本文研究了合法化对大麻市场创新的影响。我们构建了州-年层面关于大麻相关临床试验和专利申请的新颖数据与度量指标。采用交错双重差分模型和事件研究法，分析医用大麻合法化（MCL）和娱乐用大麻合法化（RCL）对创新的影响。研究发现，没有证据表明大麻相关临床试验对MCL或RCL有所响应。然而，RCL显著增加了大麻相关专利申请（约4.4项），而MCL的影响则较为温和（约1.4项）。值得注意的是，RCL额外激发的专利主要集中在下游产品和方法上，而非上游医学创新；MCL的影响也呈现类似模式。对专利内容的进一步分析表明，在可能引发公共健康、安全及滥用担忧的领域出现了显著增长。这些结果表明，合法化促进了大麻市场的创新，但在与健康和安全使用相关的领域增益相对较弱。我们通过文献中的多种新实证方法验证了上述发现。

title: Do ecolabel price premiums move upstream? A firm‐level analysis of the Marine Stewardship Council ecolabel
title_zh: 生态标签价格溢价是否向上游转移？基于海洋管理委员会生态标签的企业层面分析

authors: Frank Asche, Julia Bronnmann, Ingrid Kristine Pettersen, Geir Sogn‐Grundvåg
official: 官方在线 2026-01-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Ecolabels aim to promote sustainable production practices, but their effectiveness in incentivizing producers remains debated, particularly in settings where there are groups of producers being certified. This reflects similar challenges as in other producer programs, such as generic marketing and quality programs. In the case of fisheries, for instance, the evidence with respect to the existence of price premiums at the producer level is mixed. This is partly due to limited access to upstream data that captures variations in market demand for ecolabeled products. This study uses firm‐level data from the Norwegian cod supply chain, encompassing purchase and sales prices over 8 years for two firms, to assess if a premium is associated with the ecolabel of the Marine Stewardship Council (MSC). Our data highlight that the firms handle both MSC‐certified and uncertified cod, indicating that certification is one of several product attributes. We find that there is a premium associated with the MSC label and that it is passed upstream. In addition, product form, size, and market destination significantly influence value distribution, and regional market variation shows substantial premiums in Northern and Western Europe but none in Eastern Europe.
abstract_zh: 生态标签旨在促进可持续生产实践，但其激励生产者的有效性仍存争议，尤其是在涉及生产者群体认证的情境下。这反映了与其他生产者计划（如通用营销和质量计划）类似的挑战。以渔业为例，关于生产者层面是否存在价格溢价的证据并不一致。部分原因在于获取上游数据的途径有限，这些数据能够捕捉生态标签产品市场需求的变化。本研究利用挪威鳕鱼供应链的企业层面数据，涵盖两家企业8年间的采购和销售价格，以评估海洋管理委员会（MSC）生态标签是否与溢价相关。我们的数据表明，这些企业同时处理MSC认证和未认证的鳕鱼，表明认证仅是众多产品属性之一。我们发现，MSC标签确实与溢价相关，且该溢价向上游传递。此外，产品形态、规格和市场目的地显著影响价值分配，区域市场差异显示北欧和西欧存在显著溢价，而东欧则无溢价。

title: Bridging historical discontinuities: a framework for regionalization of input-output tables
title_zh: 弥合历史断裂：投入产出表区域化框架
title_primary: 弥合历史断裂：投入产出表区域化框架
title_secondary: Bridging historical discontinuities: a framework for regionalization of input-output tables
authors: Xiaohua Xia, Rui Li, Mengai Liu, Xintong Zhu, Chunping An
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study tackles the challenge of constructing long-term, consistent input-output tables (IOTs) for nations experiencing significant geopolitical shifts. This study proposes a methodological framework that integrates the Bidimensional Location Quotient (2DLQ) for estimating intra-regional flows and a Double-Constrained Gravity Model (DCGM) for inter-regional trade. We apply this 2DLQ-DCGM framework to the regional disaggregation of the Soviet Union’s IOTs in 1987. Using the actual IOTs of the Soviet republics in 1987 as a benchmark, this study first compares and analyzes the performance implications of different parameterization approaches in the 2DLQ, thereby validating the importance of incorporating regional structural data and the feasibility of the cross-entropy method in data-scarce scenarios. In the estimation of trade flows, this study investigates how different model specifications affect estimation accuracy. Furthermore, it extends the DCGM by incorporating factors of industrial specialization and spatial correlation. These findings contribute to the development of long-term, consistent global input-output databases and offer valuable guidance for future regionalization studies in complex geopolitical contexts.
abstract_zh: 本研究针对经历重大地缘政治变迁的国家在构建长期一致投入产出表（IOTs）方面所面临的挑战，提出了一种方法论框架，该框架整合了用于估算区域内流量的二维区位商（2DLQ）与用于区域间贸易的双约束引力模型（DCGM）。我们将此2DLQ-DCGM框架应用于1987年苏联投入产出表的区域分解。以1987年各苏维埃共和国的实际投入产出表为基准，本研究首先比较并分析了2DLQ中不同参数化方法的性能影响，从而验证了纳入区域结构数据的重要性及交叉熵方法在数据稀缺情境下的可行性。在贸易流量估算中，本研究探讨了不同模型设定如何影响估算精度。此外，通过纳入产业专业化与空间相关性因素，本研究对DCGM进行了扩展。这些发现有助于发展长期一致的全球投入产出数据库，并为未来复杂地缘政治背景下的区域化研究提供了宝贵指导。

title: A spatial theory of ostracism
title_zh: 驱逐的社会空间理论
title_primary: 驱逐的社会空间理论
title_secondary: A spatial theory of ostracism
authors: Tomohiko Kawamori, K. Yamaguchi
official: 官方在线 2015-01-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We investigate a variant of the Hotelling–Downs model where at least two politicians choose their policies in a general policy space under ostracism with each voter voting for the least preferred politician and the politician with the most votes being expelled. We show that if there are at least three politicians, or if the policy space is an inner product space and the support of the distribution of voters’ ideal policies is connected, it is necessary and sufficient for a Nash equilibrium that every politician chooses the same policy in a certain set. Furthermore, we show that under mild assumptions, there exists a Nash equilibrium for a sufficiently large population of politicians.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个Hotelling–Downs模型的变体，在该模型中，至少两位政治家在一般政策空间内，在放逐制度下选择其政策，每位选民投票给最不偏好的政治家，得票最多的政治家被驱逐。我们证明，如果政治家数量至少为三位，或者政策空间为内积空间且选民理想政策分布的支持集是连通的，那么每位政治家都选择某一特定集合中的相同政策，是纳什均衡的必要且充分条件。此外，我们证明在温和假设下，对于足够大的政治家群体，存在纳什均衡。
